target_customer: Frontier AI labs buying expert-collected voice, RL-environment and robotics training data
problem: AI labs need high-quality training and evaluation data made by people who actually do the job (contact-centre QA leads, claims handlers, shopkeepers).
business_model: Services-style data delivery contracts (per-hour/per-task, pricing not found)
product_category: AI training data and RL environments

founders.name: Kshitij Dixit
previous_startups: Zeo Auto (YC W20; company says it reached $2M ARR and profitability)

founders.name: Poorva Dixit
education: IIT Kharagpur, dual degree in computer science

technical_complexity.rationale: Mostly operations: recruiting experts, collecting and QA-ing data; some tooling (Foundry annotation workspace, speech-to-speech RL environments), but not research-grade.

defensibility.rationale: Expert networks and lab relationships help, but data vendors are numerous and labs use several; customer concentration is a risk.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Too recent. 2025-26 coverage shows large, well-funded data vendors serving the same labs; no action against Perit found.

market_need_then: The YC page claims work with almost all frontier labs and revenue past $9M; analysts in 2026 describe labs using multiple data vendors and a shift to RL environments. Company claims, not verified.

branding.domain_note: Uses perit.ai (a .ai domain); acquisition details not found.

brand_strength.rationale: Short coined name, no meaning stated; 'Perit' resembles Peritus.ai and other lookalikes in search. No community or press about the brand.

outcome_analysis: Perit.AI is a Fall 2026 YC company run by repeat YC founders, selling expert-made voice, RL and robotics data to AI labs. It says it passed $9M in revenue and has 47 staff, a very strong claimed start, but this is self-reported, no outside round was found and the cohort has not yet reached Demo Day. Main risks are customer concentration and competition from Scale AI, Surge and Mercor.
notes: Dealroom lists $125K raised and a September 2026 founding; this is a single aggregator, so no round was recorded. Founder bios differ across YC and Dealroom (Dealroom lists Reliance Jio and Flipkart); YC page used. Zeo Auto's scale is stated as 140+ countries on YC page and 100+ in the launch post. The YC description of Poorva as 'ex-Google Cloud AI' is from the company text. No dated competitor sources exist for Sept 2026; vendors named in outcome_analysis only. Name origin not found. Founders' age not stated. Directory has the company as Fall 2026 and active.
